For outdoor camping, I recommend a portable power station with a LiFePO4 (LFP) battery, which generally offers a longer lifespan and better durability than traditional lithium-ion battery chemistries.

The best size depends on whether you're charging phones and laptops, running a camping fridge, or powering appliances.

My default recommendation is around 1,000Wh for car camping. It provides a useful balance between runtime, portability, and price.
